metadata.title: Botswana Power Corporation transmission and distribution losses

primary_source.title: BPC Integrated Report 2024/2025 - Key Financial Statistics
primary_source.note: BPC's historical table reports T&D losses in GWh and system losses percent for 2015-2024.

secondary_source.title: Integrated Report 2023
secondary_source.note: Narrative reports 642,002 MWh lost in 2023 and rounds the share to 15%.

metadata.scope_warning: BPC reports combined transmission and distribution system losses and notes that these include technical losses and revenue leakages. A transmission-only DC/I2R model must not be expected to equal this total exactly.

report_cross_checks.name: AFREC Africa Energy Balance 2025
report_cross_checks.verification_note: These Botswana values are transcribed from the user-supplied GridIQ Solutions Report, which cites AFREC. The AFREC publication page was verified, but the Botswana row was not independently extracted into this bundle.
